tasks.title: Config reload is a hand-written list, so every new setting is dead until someone remembers it
tasks.description:
**Antonio, 2026-08-11: *"this is not the first time we need to change something to make reload working. WHY??? this api should work independent of where it is called from but always the same issue arise."*** He is right, and it has now happened at least three times.

# The shape of the bug

There is **no config→state API**. There are two paths that each read the config independently:

- **`heca/src/app/startup.rs`** builds `AppState` from `AppConfig` while constructing it (a struct
  literal plus `layout_options_from`).
- **`heca/src/main.rs::reload_config` (line ~157)** copies a **hand-written list of 13 fields** back
  onto the live state: `theme`, `programs`, `appearance`, `command_palette_size`, `search_case`,
  `search_history`, `font_config`, `prefix_combo`, `widget_keymap`, `action_shortcuts`,
  `mouse_enabled`, `auto_scroll_edge`, `shell_integration_enabled`,
  `pane_renamed_add_process_name`.

A setting that is not on that list is **live in the file and dead in the app**: it takes effect at
startup and `prefix+Shift+r` silently does nothing. Nothing fails, nothing warns, and the author of
the new setting has no reason to look at `main.rs`.

**Most recently (2026-08-11):** `overview_zoom`, `overview_gap` and the new `overview_zoom_from` are
in `LayoutOptions` (`session.options`), which reload never touched — so Antonio edited them, pressed
reload, and nothing changed. Fixed by adding *one more line to the list*, which is the same mistake
again. `center_focused_column` and the pane `gaps` were in the same hole.

# What to build

**One projection, called from both paths.** `apply_config(state: &mut AppState, cfg: &AppConfig)`
sets **every** field derived from config, and:

- `startup` calls it immediately after constructing the state shell (window/GPU/session/backends are
  not config-derived and stay where they are);
- `reload_config` calls it and does nothing else config-related;
- `layout_options_from` (already extracted, `app/startup.rs`) is called from inside it.

Then adding a setting is one edit in one place, and it reloads for free.

# The part that makes it stay fixed

A list can be forgotten again, so the guard has to be structural rather than a promise:

- **Preferred:** make the config-derived fields their own struct on `AppState` (e.g.
  `state.from_config: ConfigDerived`) built by one `From<&AppConfig>`. Then a new field cannot
  compile without being constructed there, and reload is `state.from_config = (&cfg).into()`.
  Exhaustiveness does the remembering.
- **Otherwise:** a test that walks `SettingsConfig`'s fields (the same way
  `every_declared_argument_is_read_by_the_action` walks the action args) and fails when one is not
  read by `apply_config`. Weaker, because it cannot see a field read into a *derived* value.

# Edge cases

- **Some state must survive a reload** — `reload_config` already carries a comment about not
  overwriting the user's working settings. Identify which of the 13 are "reset to config" vs "keep
  what the user changed at runtime", and say which in the code rather than by omission.
- `widget_keymap` / `action_shortcuts` / `prefix_combo` are *derived* (built by
  `build_widget_keymap`, `ActionShortcuts::from_index`), not copied — the projection must rebuild
  them, which is what reload already does and startup does separately.
- `session.options` must be reassigned **and** anything cached from it recomputed; a layout change
  needs `after_config_change`.

# Verification

Change `overview_zoom`, the pane gap, `command_palette_size` and a keybinding in
`~/.config/heca/config.toml`, press `prefix+Shift+r`, and see all four take effect — then add a new
setting and confirm it reloads without touching `main.rs`.

⚠️ Note for whoever picks this up: `config.default.toml` is **embedded at compile time**, so editing
*it* and reloading proves nothing. The user file is `~/.config/heca/config.toml`.
